sources.role: Planner, explainer and executive report agents
sources.usage_detail: LLM_MODE=fixture. Reasoning replays committed artefacts, so openrouter is not contacted on any request. A key being present does not change that.

sources.name: Aviation Weather Center METAR/TAF
sources.usage_detail: WEATHER_MODE=fixture. Conditions come from the committed METAR snapshot; the Aviation Weather Center is not contacted.
sources.note: The snapshot is a recording of a real AWC response, replayed rather than fetched.

sources.name: Flight status
sources.role: Observed departure state, overlaid on the scheduled board
sources.usage_detail: FLIGHT_STATUS_MODE=fixture. Observed state comes from the committed snapshot; no vendor API is called.

sources.name: Passenger notifications
sources.usage_detail: Nothing is delivered to a recipient: messages would be recorded as simulated, and none has been generated yet.

sources.name: MoCA Passenger Charter · Feb 2019 · pending CAR verification
sources.role: Entitlement figures cited in plans and reports
sources.usage_detail: Entitlement figures are cited from this pack, and the badge renders the pack's own label rather than one composed from the configured mode.
sources.licence: Government of India publication; redistribution not yet confirmed
sources.note: Official but dated. The source PDF hash is not archived, so verified mode stays blocked.

sources.name: Airports and runways
sources.usage_detail: A committed snapshot of a real public-domain dataset. Real in origin, and read from disk rather than fetched.

sources.name: Flight schedules
sources.role: The scheduled board every derived delay is measured against
sources.usage_detail: Generated by this project with a fixed seed. No real airline schedule data is used anywhere in the product.
sources.note: AIKosh is a candidate real source, but its file, schema and licence are not archived, so schedules stay synthetic and labelled.

sources.name: Passengers and bookings
sources.role: Who is on each flight, and the priority ranking
sources.usage_detail: Generated by this project with a fixed seed. No real personal data exists in any code path.

sources.name: Hotel inventory
sources.usage_detail: Generated by this project with a fixed seed. Room counts, rates and holds are synthetic throughout.

sources.usage_detail: Generated by this project with a fixed seed.
